summary: Remote-controlled shell/PTY driven by WebRTC data channel to api.factiii.com
details: @factiii/runner is a remote-agent CLI that pairs to api.factiii.com, opens a WebRTC peer connection via node-datachannel, and routes messages received on the data channel into local PTYs and child_process spawn/exec on the host, giving the paired remote client command execution on the machine running the agent. The capability is the advertised product function and is documented in the README ("pairs with the Factiii web/mobile clients over WebRTC"). Pairing yields a JWT via a browser flow, an optional connection password is supported, and credentials are stored AES-256-GCM at rest. The channel is outbound-only (no local listener bound), the control plane host matches the package's publisher/homepage, and the daemon starts only when the user explicitly runs the `factiii-runner start` subcommand — no install, preinstall, postinstall, or prepare lifecycle hooks are declared, no top-level import side effects start the agent, and no boot/login persistence is installed. No collateral harvesting of installer secrets (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser or wallet stores, whole-environment dumps) is present, and no secondary undisclosed channel is wired alongside the WebRTC path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
